entries: The whole crew worked for the {rival}, and {first} was the only thief.
{the_someone:human} had worked both sides, out of {MOTIVE}.
The loot in {landmark:built} was only paper; {the_someone:human} had the fortune.
{CLOSE:human} had misdrawn the blueprints, out of {MOTIVE}.
{the_disaster:strikes} was part of the plan; {the_someone:human} had arranged it {MANNER}.
{the_thing:portable} was never the prize; it opened {landmark:built}.
The getaway car was waiting, but {SOMEONE:human,!plural} drove it away {MANNER}.
{first} had stolen {the_thing:!living} two days ago unawares, and the {rival} noticed.
The mark was a stand-in: {the_someone:human} owned {landmark:built} all along.
{the_message:physical} was the {rival}'s own invitation, a test of {first}.
{CLOSE:human} walked off with the take {MANNER}, out of {MOTIVE}, and left {first} the blame.
The inside man at {landmark:built} was {the_someone:human}, who had no plan to leave.
